decisions.reason: The reporting dimensions and conversion metric do not change the deferred direct Sales Navigator-to-HubSpot synchronization requirement.
The client specifies HubSpot funnel reporting by Contact Source and stage but does not change how leads are transferred from HubSpot to MeetAlfred.
The reporting request does not alter the workflow for creating a MeetAlfred campaign or configuring its Zap.
The HubSpot funnel-reporting specification is unrelated to the campaign domain name, registrar, or provisioning scope.
